item.description: At a recent auction, a rare lock of George Washington’s hair sold for an impressive $4,000. Gadsby’s granddaughter later cherished the lock alongside a portrait of the first president, making it a remarkable piece of history. Notably, Washington's hair has previously commanded prices nearing $40,000 at auctions, alongside other treasured memorabilia. Publicado también por: BBC News - World.
